description: Over-representation analysis: test which GO terms (biological process / molecular function / cellular component) and Reactome pathways are statistically enriched in a query gene list versus a background, using the hypergeometric test with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction across all tested terms. Uses bundled GO Consortium + Reactome reference data (human only). KEGG is not included (its license does not permit bundling gene sets).

background.description: Custom background/universe gene symbols. If omitted, defaults to every gene present in the bundled GO+Reactome dataset (the 'only annotated genes' convention, as used by g:Profiler) rather than the whole genome.

collections.description: Which term collections to test. Defaults to all four.

genes.description: Query gene symbols (human, e.g. "TP53"). Case-insensitive. Capped at 5000.

maxTermSize.description: Skip terms/pathways with more than this many background genes (matches clusterProfiler's default).

minTermSize.description: Skip terms/pathways with fewer than this many background genes.

name: functional_enrichment
title: Functional enrichment (GO + Reactome)
